prompt:
Implement this service.

<spec>
name: artifact-registry-metadata
description: Stores metadata (not the blobs) for versioned build artifacts.
endpoints:
- method: GET
  path: /health
- method: GET
  path: /metrics
- method: POST
  path: /artifacts
  description: 'body {name, version, sha256: 64 lowercase hex chars, size_bytes: int
    >= 0}; 201; 409 if name+version exists; 400 if any field missing or invalid or
    malformed JSON'
- method: GET
  path: /artifacts
  description: 200 JSON list of all artifacts
- method: GET
  path: /artifacts/{name}
  description: 200 JSON list of all versions of that artifact; 404 if none
- method: GET
  path: /artifacts/{name}/{version}
  description: 200 one artifact; 404 if unknown
metrics:
- name: artifacts_total
  type: gauge
  help: Stored artifact versions
- name: artifact_uploads_total
  type: counter
  help: Accepted registrations
behaviors:
- Same name with a different version is allowed
probes:
- method: POST
  path: /artifacts
  expect_status:
  - 201
  body: '{"name": "svc", "version": "1.0.0", "sha256": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "size_bytes": 10}'
- method: POST
  path: /artifacts
  expect_status:
  - 409
  body: '{"name": "svc", "version": "1.0.0", "sha256": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "size_bytes": 10}'
- method: POST
  path: /artifacts
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"name": "svc", "version": "1.0.1", "sha256": "xyz", "size_bytes": 10}'
- method: GET
  path: /artifacts/svc
  expect_status:
  - 200
- method: GET
  path: /artifacts/svc/1.0.0
  expect_status:
  - 200
- method: GET
  path: /artifacts/nope
  expect_status:
  - 404
- method: GET
  path: /artifacts/svc/9.9.9
  expect_status:
  - 404
</spec>

Already provided by templates (do NOT write or register these):
- main.go: `func newServer() http.Handler` serves GET /health and GET /metrics, then calls
  `registerRoutes(mux)`. Do not register /health or /metrics yourself.
- metrics.go: Prometheus variables you must keep up to date from your handlers:
- artifactsTotal  (gauge) -> exposed as `artifacts_total`; use Set/Inc/Dec/Add
- artifactUploadsTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `artifact_uploads_total`; use Inc/Add

You must write these files:
1. handlers.go - defines `func registerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux)` that registers ONLY these routes:
   - POST /artifacts  body {name, version, sha256: 64 lowercase hex chars, size_bytes: int >= 0}; 201; 409 if name+version exists; 400 if any field missing or invalid or malformed JSON
   - GET /artifacts  200 JSON list of all artifacts
   - GET /artifacts/{name}  200 JSON list of all versions of that artifact; 404 if none
   - GET /artifacts/{name}/{version}  200 one artifact; 404 if unknown
   Keep state in memory (you may add store.go). Return JSON with proper status codes; reject
   malformed input with 400. The behaviors in the spec are verified at runtime.
2. handlers_test.go - at least 3 `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` functions using
   net/http/httptest against `newServer()`. Never bind real ports; tests must finish in seconds.
3. README.md - must contain: an "## Endpoints" section listing EVERY spec endpoint (including
   /health and /metrics) as `METHOD /path` in backticks, and a "## Metrics" section listing EVERY
   metric name in backticks. Only document things that actually exist.
